## What happened

This notice confirms the registry change freeze recorded under ref FRZ-0301. The freeze is titled "Registry change freeze" and starts on 2026-10-19. It remains in effect until 2027-01-29. The notice provides the applicable period for the freeze and should be used as the reference for registry feed change planning during this time.

## Cause

The cause of the freeze is Ministry year-end. This operational requirement means that registry feed changes are paused for the period identified in this notice.

## Effect

No interface changes to the registry feed may be made while the freeze is in effect. Teams requiring clarification should contact the service desk and quote ref FRZ-0301. Any proposed registry feed interface change should be held until the freeze has ended on 2027-01-29.
